# Bread baking schedule

Friday evening: feed the starter, see [[sourdough-starter-feeding]]. Saturday morning: mix,
fold three times, shape, and proof in the fridge. Saturday afternoon: bake at 240 degrees
with steam for twenty minutes, then 220 degrees until the crust is deep brown.

Sesame rings are a side project, see [[istanbul-simit]].
